newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end down after tracking Dow swings.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end down after tracking Dow swings.

text.p: Madrid stocks slipped lower to close down on Friday after a choppy session spent tracking movements in Wall Street other key stock markets.
The general index down 1.05 points, 0.26 percent, at 403.13. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares closed down 12.88 points, 0.28 percent, at 4,650.99.
"We have had an afternoon of great ups and downs due to the volatility seen on Wall Street," said one dealer.
Trading in telecommunications company Telefonica and electricty company Iberdrola accounted for 37 percent of total volume. Turnover was high at 59,600 billion pesetas.

Traders said in the medium term they expected stocks would recover their enthusiasm after positive inflation data and a cut by the Bank of Spain in its key money rate by 50 basis points to 6.25 percent.
"The rises in bonds and Wall Street after the Madrid bourse closed give a more positive short-term outlook for stocks," added one trader.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica ended down 20 pesetas at 2,875 and Repsol closed up 10 pesetas at 4,500.
Iberdrola closed down 30 pesetas at 1,555 pesetas.
